questions.stem: A neonate born through C-section was brought directly from the gynae O.T. to the paediatric Neonatal intensive care unit(NICU) for no respiratory efforts or no cry immediately after birth. Neonatal resuscitation was started, still, the baby was apneic with a heart rate of 78/min at 1 min after birth. Spo2 levels were low to normal observed in this neonate. What should be the target spo2 levels at 5min of birth?
